contractGoal: Record where production secrets are managed and reviewed without reading secret values.

requiredConfirmationFields.name: secret-manager-or-source-type
requiredConfirmationFields.description: Operator confirms the production secret manager or injection source type.

requiredConfirmationFields.name: secret-manager-owner
requiredConfirmationFields.description: Operator confirms the owning team for the configured secret source.

requiredConfirmationFields.name: rotation-owner
requiredConfirmationFields.description: Operator confirms who owns production secret rotation.

requiredConfirmationFields.name: review-cadence
requiredConfirmationFields.description: Operator confirms the review cadence before production cutover.

requiredConfirmationFields.name: secret-value-access-boundary
requiredConfirmationFields.description: Operator confirms that this Java contract and Node consumers never read secret values.

secretValueBoundaries: Secret values are never read by this contract
Secret values are never written to static JSON samples
Secret names and raw environment variable values stay outside this repository
Node may render checklist state only
forbiddenOperations: Reading production secret values from this contract
Embedding secret values in static JSON samples
Writing secret names or raw environment variable values to this repository
Triggering Java runtime configuration changes from Node
